Jon Weber is a musician who embraces challenges. His virtuoso piano can be heard in the role of soloist, sideman and vocal accompanist. He is a prolific composer/arranger and has recorded his original work, most notably on the 2004 release “Simple Complex.” Jon recently welcomed a new challenge following Marian McPartland as the new host of NPR’s Piano Jazz Rising Stars.
Jon was interviewed in Clinton, New York on June 2, 2012, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m welcoming Jon Weber to campus. Welcome, on our 200th Anniversary.
